Nintendo is one of the greatest video game companies of all time, and they have further established their name with the Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2, which changed the game with their hybrid system. With games like The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, it dominates both markets. However, it used to do this separately with one home and one handheld console.

Nintendo has so many handheld systems, but the best is arguably the Nintendo DS, which is why this list will rank the ten greatest video games on the DS. Based on aspects such as gameplay, design, narrative, visuals, originality, fan opinion, critical acclaim, how well it represents the console, and overall quality, these are the go-to handheld gaming experiences.

blocks.c: Mario and Luigi walking around an ice world in New Super Mario Bros. Wii

blocks.x: The face of Nintendo is undoubtedly Mario, and while the plumber is more associated with home consoles, he’s made his way to the DS a couple of times, including New Super Mario Bros. It is a tale as old as gaming itself, with Bowser capturing Princess Peach, which forces Mario to run and jump around the kingdom in order to defeat King Koopa and rescue Peach.

The 2D Mario formula is nostalgic and timeless, but for a bit, it was out of the spotlight. But New Super Mario Bros. brought it back after 14 years in peak condition. The precise physics-based design and platforming gameplay combined for a fluid and exhilarating experience. Not to mention it was miraculously ported onto the DS, a console that no one would expect to run it so well.

blocks.c: The cover for Pokémon Mystery Dungeon Explorers Of Sky

blocks.x: While Mario is the face of Nintendo, Pokémon is the figurehead of all handheld consoles, including the DS. Fans can expect multiple games from this franchise, including spinoffs such as Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky. Waking up as a Pokémon with amnesia, players must team up with a partner and set out into dungeons and solve the many mysteries in them while trying to prevent time from stopping.

It may not be the highest-rated DS game, but it is one of the best in a beloved franchise. Explorers of Sky is an ignored video game that has aged perfectly, boasting one of the best-written stories on the platform. The roguelike mechanics are different for Pokémon, but this game handles them perfectly, resulting in a fleshed-out narrative that is beautiful and emotional.

blocks.c: paltforming gameplay in Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story

blocks.x: If Mario somehow isn’t enough on his own, then he has a brother to help him in adventures, which leads to games like Mario & Luigi: Bowser’s Inside Story. After a freak incident leaves the entire Mushroom Kingdom inside Bowser's stomach, Mario and Luigi must venture through his internal organs to defeat him and return the kingdom to its natural place.

The DS was full of imaginative and creative games, and Bowser’s Inside Story was one of them. It constantly broke the fourth wall for a layer of meta humor that paired nicely with its comedic writing. Not to mention, the dual-gameplay mechanic had players controlling Bowser on the top screen and the brothers on the bottom one, utilizing the console perfectly to cement Bowser’s Inside Story as one of the best DS games ever.

blocks.c: zelda-phantom-hourglass

blocks.x: Like Mario, The Legend of Zelda is a franchise mostly known for its home console games, but one DS masterpiece was The Legend of Zelda: Phantom Hourglass. This sequel to The Wind Waker has Link sailing the high seas in order to rescue Tetra from a ghost ship, but luckily he has the help of Captain Lineback and a fairy named Ciela.

Zelda games have always been creative, but Phantom Hourglass takes it to the next level, pushing the bounds of the DS to the max. The mapping movement, combat, and puzzle-solving were done entirely through the touchscreen, giving a tactile sense of play that is so interactive and engaging, proving why it is one of the best Zelda games ever.

blocks.x: One of the best-selling Nintendo franchises is Mario Kart, so naturally Mario Kart DS would become the DS’ biggest hit. Racers from across the Mushroom Kingdom gather in order to compete in a series of Grand Prix races to determine who is the best kart driver.

Nintendo has always been a multiplayer-friendly company, and Mario Kart DS revolutionized handheld co-op by introducing Wi-Fi connectivity, meaning gamers could race globally. The mix of classic nostalgic courses and innovative new ones created a variety of gameplay experiences that were a mechanical high point for the franchise and the console.
